question.text: Ms. Priya's PMS STCG on equity Rs. 10 lakh (held < 12 months). Tax (post Jul 2024):

explanation.text: The Logic: STCG on listed equity = 20% * 10,00,000 = Rs. 2,00,000. The Trap: 15% rate no longer applies. Cross-Exam Context: Post Budget-2024 rule. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Hold beyond 12 months when possible; savings can be meaningful.
